strict_primary_limitations: B2 uses MMseqs2 against frozen Swiss-Prot rather than eggNOG seed-ortholog output, because eggNOG-mapper does not expose a rankable leakage-filterable hit list.
B3 excludes PDB chains without SIFTS-resolved UniProt accessions.
Structure homology exclusions use the precomputed Swiss-Prot sequence catalog, not Foldseek fident.
